newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares up, focus on cyclicals.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares up, focus on cyclicals.

text.p: Norwegian shares closed higher on Tuesday with the market focusing on cyclical shares and blue chip stock in general.
The Total share index closed 0.47 percent up at 1,106.36 points. Turnover was a heavy 1.3 billion crowns.
Industrial holding group Aker RGI's A share rose nine crowns to close at 188 crown after announcing the 1996 results.
Metals maker Elkem's A share was up two crowns at 120 crowns and industrial giant Norsk Hydro rose 3.50 crowns to 349 crowns.
Engineering and construction group Kvaerner was up one crown at 371 crowns after the company announced it had won an order for two chemical tankers.
